name: Asset Alchemist
title: Cinematic Continuity & Video Vault
subtitle: Cinematic Continuity & Video Vault
features: Video Vault (Studio 31): import local MP4, MOV, M4V, WebM or OGV files and retain the actual video bytes in device/browser IndexedDB between visits
Dedicated local cinema player with native iPhone video controls, saved playback positions, cover snapshots, favorites, collections, searching and sorting
Video Vault stores lightweight metadata separately from large binary files to avoid loading all videos into iPhone memory
Media Theater can send its current video playlist into the persistent Video Vault with one action; direct topbar and Command Center launchers
Video Vault checks site storage limits and offers a best-effort persistent-storage request, with honest warnings about website-data deletion and iOS eviction
New iPhone safe-area navigation dock with Home, Videos, Back, Forward and searchable Studios drawer
Mobile studio picker offers pinned favorites, recent studio history, edge-swipe back and safe preservation of current studio state
Animation Forge adds smooth 15, 20 and 24 FPS GIF exports, up to 120 frames, and accurate frame-delay pacing
GIF extraction waits briefly for a composited video frame after seeking on supported browsers to reduce duplicated frames
Animation Forge additionally accepts iPhone MOV and M4V inputs where browser video decoding supports their codecs
All 30 previously built studios, Reactor IV, Master Visual Identity, Token Foundry, GitHub Pages site and Discord launcher preserved
